tools.name: list_rules
tools.description:
Retrieve persistent user-defined instructions that extend the system prompt.

Returned rules must be inserted into the conversation context before
processing user messages and treated as additional system-level instructions.

Should normally be called once at conversation startup.

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Semantic search for concepts by meaning (not just keywords). Returns most relevant stored knowledge

tools.name: add_concept
tools.description: Add new concept (knowledge unit) with semantic embedding for long-term memory

tools.name: get_expert
tools.description: Get expert info: description, code, parameters, creation date, update date

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Get list of all unrevoked tokens

tools.name: create_token
tools.description: Create new API token for user authentication

tools.name: search_kv
tools.description: Semantic search across stored key-value pairs by meaning

tools.name: get_kv
tools.description: Get key-value pair by key name

tools.name: set_kv
tools.description: Create or update a key-value pair with semantic embedding

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Add new target with description for semantic search

tools.name: get_current_profile_and_agent
tools.description: Get current profile ID and agent ID

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: Delete profile. Agents in the profile are not deleted

tools.name: duckduckgo_search
tools.description: Searches DuckDuckGo for the given query and returns the results

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report a bug, limitation, missing capability, or unexpected behavior of the available tools or platform that developers should know about.
